name: mallard
description: Get your Copilot spend all in a row. A live dashboard of cost, model usage, and where every credit goes — read from Copilot's local logs. No sign-in required, no telemetry.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace Mallard ignores a workspace-level override of the Copilot OpenTelemetry path, so a downloaded project cannot point it at other files. Every other Mallard setting is user-level (application or machine scope) and is never read from a workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Mallard reads usage from log files on the local machine, so it works with virtual workspaces, but repository and branch attribution needs a real folder on disk and is unavailable for virtual folders.

mallard.monthlyBudget.description: Monthly budget in USD. 0 disables budget tracking and the budget alerts.

mallard.includedCredits.description: Premium requests included in your Copilot plan each month. Colours the spend gauge and drives the "% of included" alerts.

mallard.dailyCreditAlert.description: Warn once a day when the day's credits exceed this. 0 disables the alert.

mallard.alerts.velocityEnabled.description: Warn when credits are being spent faster than the velocity threshold.

mallard.alerts.velocityCreditsPerHour.description: Credits per hour above which the velocity alert fires. 0 disables it.

metric.description: What to compare: a fixed metric, or model:<id>.credits|cost / repo:<name>.credits|cost.

value.description: Threshold the metric is compared against.

cooldown.description: Minimum time between firings: a positive number and m/h/d/w, e.g. "30m", "1.5h", "2d".

notify.description: Show a notification when the rule fires.

restrict.description: Raise the (notification-only) usage-limit restriction while the rule matches.

clearBelow.description: Lift the restriction once the metric falls below this value, instead of as soon as the rule stops matching.

mallard.alerts.rules.description: Custom threshold alerts: each rule compares one metric with a value, e.g. { "id": "big-day", "metric": "today.credits", "op": ">", "value": 200, "cooldown": "6h", "severity": "warning" }. Edit in settings.json.

mallard.branchBudgets.description: Per-branch credit caps keyed by branch name, e.g. { "main": 500, "feature/x": 120 }. A branch over its cap raises an alert.

mallard.currency.description: Display currency as an ISO 4217 code (e.g. EUR). Costs are converted from USD with daily exchange rates; metric exports always use USD. Also set by the dashboard's currency selector.

enumDescriptions: Fixed Swiss duotone: one red accent plus a grayscale ramp.
Derive the accent from your VS Code theme (validated for contrast and colour-blindness).
mallard.palette.description: Dashboard chart palette. Both modes keep the duotone structure and are checked for accessibility.

mallard.display.dailyBarsWindow.description: Days shown in the daily bars, cumulative area and token charts.

mallard.display.heatmapWeeks.description: Weeks shown in the activity heatmap (52 is a full year).

mallard.display.topN.description: How many models and repositories to show in ranked lists.

mallard.enabledConnectors.description: Which usage connectors Mallard ingests from. Set by the onboarding flow when both Copilot and Claude Code are installed (run "Mallard: Show Onboarding" to redo it). Changing this requires reloading the window.

mallard.copilotOtelPath.description: Override path to Copilot's OpenTelemetry export target: a JSONL file, or a .sqlite/.db database. Blank auto-detects it from github.copilot.chat.otel.outfile. Run "Mallard: Enable Copilot Usage Tracking" to set it up automatically.

mallard.pricingManifestUrl.description: Override URL for the pricing manifest JSON. Blank uses the auto-refreshed default. Applies without a reload.

mallard.refreshIntervalMinutes.description: How often Mallard re-reads logs and recomputes the snapshot, in minutes. Lower values update the dashboard sooner at the cost of CPU.

mallard.dataRetentionDays.description: Days of raw per-request events to keep before they are rolled up into daily totals. Higher values use more disk. Changing this requires reloading the window.

enumDescriptions: Use VS Code's built-in GitHub sign-in.
Use the personal access token stored by "Mallard: Set GitHub Personal Access Token"; never prompts for sign-in.
mallard.githubBilling.mode.description: How Mallard authenticates for GitHub billing data.

mallard.githubBilling.org.description: GitHub organization slug for org-level Copilot billing (needs read:org). Blank shows your personal billing.

mallard.server.url.description: Base URL of your self-hosted Mallard server (e.g. https://mallard.example.com). Used as the webhook endpoint and as the fallback MQTT WebSocket host.

enumDescriptions: POST usage metrics as JSON to the server's HTTP webhook endpoint.
Publish usage metrics over MQTT/WebSocket to the server.
mallard.export.transport.description: Transport used for metric export. Set mallard.server.url first. Leave blank to disable.

id.description: Stable id (letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash). Namespaces this target's stored credentials: do not change it once credentials are set.

name.description: Label shown in the Mallard pickers.

mallard.export.webhookTargets.description: Extra webhook servers that mirror every payload when the transport is "webhook", as { "id", "name", "url" }. Each target's credentials are stored under its id (see "Mallard: Configure Export Fanout Targets"). Ids must be unique across webhook and MQTT targets. Edit in settings.json.

id.description: Stable id (letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash). Namespaces this target's stored credentials: do not change it once credentials are set.

name.description: Label shown in the Mallard pickers.

mallard.export.mqttTargets.description: Extra MQTT brokers that mirror every payload when the transport is "mqtt", as { "id", "name", "url" } with a wss:// URL. Each broker's password is stored under its id. Ids must be unique across webhook and MQTT targets. Edit in settings.json.

enumDescriptions: Send an X-API-Key header. Run "Mallard: Set Webhook API Key" to store it.
Send an Authorization: Bearer header. Run "Mallard: Set Webhook Bearer Token" to store it.
Authenticate with a client TLS certificate. Set mallard.shared.certificate.*.
mallard.webhook.auth.description: Auth method for the webhook transport. Credentials are kept in SecretStorage via the Mallard credential commands, never in settings.

mallard.mqtt.url.description: MQTT broker WebSocket URL (e.g. wss://mallard.example.com/mqtt). Overrides mallard.server.url for MQTT. Only TLS URLs are accepted.

mallard.mqtt.username.description: MQTT username, sent in the CONNECT packet as broker metadata. The Mallard server identifies you by the shared broker password; the username is not used for identification.

mallard.shared.certificate.file.description: Path to the PEM client certificate file. Used when the webhook auth is "certificate".

mallard.shared.certificate.keyFile.description: Path to the PEM private key file paired with mallard.shared.certificate.file.

mallard.shared.certificate.caFile.description: Path to a CA bundle PEM file used to verify the server's TLS certificate.

scripts.pretest: bun run compile-tests && bun run compile && bun run check-types && bun run lint
